desc: Derive optimal descending-greedy formula: for each x, A_x = 1 + count{y < x | pos[y] < pos[x]}, answer = sum_{x=1}^N (T_{x-1} - T_{A_x-1}).
Implement Python solution: parse N and P, build pos, use Fenwick over positions, iterate x=1..N, compute rank = bit.sum(pos[x]-1)+1, add triangular difference, insert pos[x], print answer.
Verify solution on public samples and basic edge cases (sorted, reverse, N=2) with O(N log N) performance.
